property_summary: For any non-empty _tos and any addresses, C.transfer either successfully calls transferFrom on every target and returns true, or it reverts; if it returns, it must return true.
If transfer returns (does not revert) then it must return true.
If transfer does not revert then it returns true (for non-empty _tos).
If transfer returns (does not revert) for a non-empty _tos, it must return true and must have attempted calls to caddress (i.e., the call must return true overall).
For any non-empty _tos and any inputs, C.transfer either reverts or returns true; equivalently, it never returns false when _tos.length > 0.
